DASH-041.notes: Chart animation and CSS transitions are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

DEMO-013.notes: One synthetic Indian trading company with ~7 months of journals. The other demo companies and record types are not done.

DEMO-021.notes: Demo org is named "(SYNTHETIC DATA)", flagged is_demo, and the seed refuses to run when NODE_ENV=production.

GL-001.notes: Foundation in place (ledger, journals, periods, reports). Most GL capabilities below are still to do.

evidence: apps/api/test/ledger.e2e.test.ts › validates hierarchy, subtype and uniqueness
apps/api/test/ledger.e2e.test.ts › validates hierarchy, subtype and uniqueness

GL-008.notes: Adjusting journals are ordinary posted journals with a memo; there is no separate adjusting-entry type or period-end workflow yet.

evidence: apps/api/test/ledger.e2e.test.ts › reverses a posted entry exactly once and nets it to zero
packages/accounting-engine/test/journal.test.ts › builds a reversal that nets the original to zero

GL-010.notes: Opening balances are entered as a journal on the first day; there is no dedicated opening-balance import screen yet.

GL-013.notes: The ledger records accruals (AR/AP based entries). Accrual vs cash reporting basis switch is not done.

evidence: apps/api/test/ledger.e2e.test.ts › blocks posting into a locked period and allows it again after unlock
apps/api/test/ledger.e2e.test.ts › builds an account ledger with opening and running balances

GL-030.notes: Journal lines accept free-form dimension key/values (stored as JSON). Dimension masters (cost centers, departments, etc.), validation and reporting by dimension are not done.

evidence: apps/api/test/ledger.e2e.test.ts › refuses an unbalanced posted entry even if inserted directly in SQL
apps/api/test/ledger.e2e.test.ts › converts foreign-currency lines to the functional currency
apps/api/test/ledger.e2e.test.ts › blocks any direct change to posted entries at the database level
apps/api/test/ledger.e2e.test.ts › reverses a posted entry exactly once
apps/api/test/ledger.e2e.test.ts › idempotency and concurrency (retries, concurrent retries, 25 concurrent posts)

I18N-002.notes: Transaction currency + rate per line, functional currency per org. Rate tables, revaluation and multi-currency reporting are not done.

I18N-003.notes: Amounts use Intl.NumberFormat on exact decimal strings (en-IN style grouping for INR). A per-user locale setting is not built.

MOB-001.notes: Layouts are responsive and checked at phone width; no dedicated mobile navigation pattern yet.

NAV-001.notes: Sidebar and org switcher exist for the M1 modules; global search and command palette are not built.

NAV-042.notes: Member list and add-by-email with a role; invitation emails and role changes are not built.

NAV-047.notes: Sidebar only shows modules that exist today.

PERF-017.notes: Correctness under concurrency is tested; throughput has not been benchmarked.

evidence: pnpm test runs unit + integration suites

QA-003.notes: Run against a real PostgreSQL database.

QA-005.notes: Playwright browser tests drive the real web app against the real API and PostgreSQL in CI.

QA-008.notes: Conversion and precision only; revaluation not built.

evidence: apps/api/test/ledger.e2e.test.ts › reverses a posted entry exactly once
apps/api/test/ledger.e2e.test.ts › produce a balanced trial balance and statements that tie out
apps/api/test/ledger.e2e.test.ts › assigns gap-free unique numbers under concurrent posting; allows only one of many concurrent reversals

QA-031.notes: The demo seed and test fixtures are deterministic; a shared fixture library for all scenarios is not done.

RULE-001.notes: Every button in the web app calls a working API; screens for unbuilt modules are not shown.

RULE-002.notes: The dashboard reads GET /reports/dashboard, computed from posted journals.

evidence: Composite (id, org_id) foreign keys in schema
SEC-001.notes: Application-level scoping plus database foreign keys. PostgreSQL row-level security is not enabled yet (see KNOWN_LIMITATIONS).

SEC-003.notes: Fixed roles: OWNER, ADMIN, ACCOUNTANT, APPROVER, VIEWER. Custom roles not done.

SEC-008.notes: Short-lived JWT held in an httpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie by the web app. Refresh tokens, revocation and session listing are not done.

SEC-012.notes: Secrets come from environment variables and are validated at startup; no secrets in code. A secrets manager integration is not done.

SEC-015.notes: Email + password (scrypt) and HS256 JWT bearer tokens.

evidence: apps/api/test/ledger.e2e.test.ts › rejects unbalanced, malformed and header-account entries

UX-015.notes: Members screen lists members and adds an existing user by email with a role. Invitation emails and role changes are not built.

AR-001.notes: Slice 1 of AR: customers, invoices, credit notes, receipts, allocation, statements, ageing. Quotes, orders, recurring billing, reminders, write-offs and the AI items are not started.

AR-009.notes: Invoices with tenant-configured tax rates. Not a statutory e-invoice format; no PDF or emailing yet.

evidence: apps/api/test/sales-purchases.e2e.test.ts › applies a credit note and settles the invoice
apps/api/test/sales-purchases.e2e.test.ts › records a partial receipt against an invoice
apps/api/test/sales-purchases.e2e.test.ts › keeps an unallocated receipt as a customer credit
apps/api/test/sales-purchases.e2e.test.ts › ageing ties to the receivables control account

AP-003.notes: Same document model as supplier bills.

evidence: apps/api/test/sales-purchases.e2e.test.ts › posts a bill to payables with recoverable input tax and pays it

AP-008.notes: Shares the receipts code path, which is tested for partial allocation; no purchases-specific partial test yet.

AP-009.notes: Unallocated vendor payment stays as a vendor credit; shares the tested receipts code path.

AP-010.notes: Vendor credits share the tested credit-note path; journal covered by engine tests.

AP-012.notes: Same ageing service as receivables; purchases ageing reconciliation is checked by the demo seed.

evidence: apps/api/test/sales-purchases.e2e.test.ts › detects a vendor's invoice number entered twice
AP-018.notes: Per vendor, case-insensitive; enforced by a partial unique index as well as the service.

TAX-002.notes: Rates are tenant-configured; no statutory rates are hard-coded.

evidence: apps/api/test/banking.e2e.test.ts › lists bank and cash accounts
BANK-001.notes: Bank and cash accounts are ledger accounts (subtype BANK/CASH).

BANK-003.notes: CSV only (comma, semicolon or tab; five date formats; single or split amount columns). OFX, QIF, MT940 and PDF are not supported yet.

evidence: apps/api/test/banking.e2e.test.ts › suggests and auto-matches only unambiguous pairs
apps/api/test/banking.e2e.test.ts › records a customer receipt from money in
apps/api/test/banking.e2e.test.ts › matches a ledger line to only one statement line
apps/api/test/banking.e2e.test.ts › records a customer receipt from money in
BANK-009.notes: Vendor payments from money-out lines share the tested receipt path.

evidence: apps/api/test/banking.e2e.test.ts › previews the figures and explains why it does not reconcile yet
BANK-013.notes: Uncleared ledger items and unmatched statement lines are listed on the reconciliation screen.

BANK-014.notes: Ledger balance, lines to review and last reconciled date per account. No live bank balances, thresholds or alerts.

evidence: apps/api/test/banking.e2e.test.ts › only owners and admins undo a reconciliation, which keeps its record
BANK-015.notes: Reconciliations are never deleted; undo keeps the record and reason; every step is in the audit trail.

BANK-017.notes: Rule-based suggestions (amount, date within 14 days, shared words). Nothing learns from past matches yet; no AI.

evidence: apps/api/test/banking.e2e.test.ts › previews without storing, then imports, and skips lines already imported
BANK-018.notes: Detects lines imported before (fingerprint per account). Does not yet flag duplicate transactions inside the books.

BANK-021.notes: Reconciliation flags when imported lines do not add up to the statement balance (missing or doubled lines). No line-level detection.

GL-032.notes: Bank and cash accounts can be reconciled. Other balance-sheet account reconciliations are not built.

evidence: apps/api/test/banking.e2e.test.ts › records a customer receipt from money in

DOC-001.notes: Files attach to invoices, bills, payments, journals and bank lines; stored in PostgreSQL with checksum, type detected from bytes, immutable, soft removal with reason. No standalone document vault, folders or search yet.

DOC-002.notes: Invoice and bill files attached to the document record.

DOC-003.notes: Receipts attach to documents, payments and journal entries.

DOC-006.notes: Files can be attached to bank statement lines through the API; no screen for it yet. Statement CSV import itself is BANK-*.

evidence: apps/api/test/attachments-approvals.e2e.test.ts › checks the bytes, not the claimed type, and refuses empty, oversized and duplicate files
DOC-018.notes: Exact duplicate files (same SHA-256) on the same record are refused. No cross-record or fuzzy duplicate detection.

AP-006.notes: Bills (and invoices, credit notes, vendor credits) can require an approval above an amount; enforced by a database trigger.

WFLOW-006.notes: Single-step approval of sales and purchase drafts by amount. No multi-level chains, escalations or approvals for other record types yet.

evidence: apps/web/e2e/approvals-flow.test.mjs › an owner sets an approval rule
UX-016.notes: One rule per document type: on/off, minimum total, separate approver.

AUDIT-006.notes: Every request, decision, withdrawal and cancellation is kept (never deleted, trigger-enforced) and audited.

AUDIT-025.notes: Approver name, time and note are stored on the request; the approver must differ from the preparer when the rule says so (database-enforced).

AUDIT-028.notes: Evidence files are linked to the records they support with a SHA-256 checksum. Audit-event-level evidence references are not modelled yet.

SEC-036.notes: Human approval gate for posting covered sales and purchase documents. Not yet applied to journals, payments or AI actions (no AI actions exist).

EXP-002.notes: Employees (new EMPLOYEE role) and other staff create, edit, submit and withdraw their own claims; tax-inclusive amounts with tax split out.

EXP-005.notes: Categories are the organisation's active expense accounts; no separate category list or per-category limits.

evidence: apps/api/test/expenses.e2e.test.ts › is reimbursed from a bank account, which clears what is owed
EXP-009.notes: One claim at a time, recorded from a bank or cash account (Dr employee reimbursements payable / Cr bank). No batch payouts or bank file generation.

EXP-010.notes: Single-step approval by anyone with approvals.decide other than the claimant (service and database trigger); approval posts the expense.

evidence: apps/api/test/expenses.e2e.test.ts › flags a receipt that looks claimed twice
EXP-018.notes: Warns when another live claim by the same person has a line with the same date and amount. Does not block; no receipt-image comparison.

EXP-021.notes: Shows when a claim has no receipts, at submission and approval. Receipts are not required by a policy.

EXP-003.notes: Receipts (photo or PDF) upload from the browser, including on a phone; there is no native mobile app or camera capture flow.

EXP-017.notes: Totals by status for a person or the organisation; no expense reports by category or period yet beyond the general ledger.

MOB-007.notes: Approvals work in the responsive web app at phone width; no mobile app.
